name: switch
useFor: Use to turn a setting or a channel on and off immediately (Phone Number, iMessage, Agent2Agent in Create Agent Identity). Put the label at the left and the switch at the right of the row, and give the switch an accessible name with aria-label or a Label. Use size sm (44 by 28) in dense lists.
constraints: A switch that needs a save button to apply
A colored track other than purple when on
source: The Inkbox console's Switch theme (a 44 by 24 track inside 4px of padding); Figma 427:2715: Toggle in the channel cards of Create Agent Identity
title: Switch
description: A 52 by 32 pill: off gray, purple when on, with a 24px white knob that slides 20px across in 120ms.
